subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: Launched in 2014 with the lion as its logo, this flagship initiative aims to encourage domestic and foreign companies to manufacture products in India, boosting the manufacturing sector's contribution to GDP and creating jobs. It is called:
explanation: Make in India (2014) targets manufacturing investment and job creation — distinct from Digital India (e-governance/digital infrastructure), Skill India (vocational training), or Startup India (entrepreneurship support).

subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: Launched in 2015 to train India's large youth population in industry-relevant vocational skills, improving employability, this mission operates through initiatives like the Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY). It is called:
explanation: Skill India (2015) focuses on vocational training and employability for the workforce, delivered via schemes like PMKVY — distinct from Make in India (manufacturing investment) or Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan (formal elementary schooling access).
